**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The contract contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee, so it meets our preferred LD position and no redline is warranted. Termination for breach, insolvency, security/service failure and force majeure all operate without any exit payment by Juniper Ridge, and §27.3 says so expressly ("without penalty"), with refunds running in our favour. The two cost-shifting mechanics we checked are legitimate: §7.3 only removes interest exposure on disputed amounts later found not due, and §22.2 recovers reasonable audit costs plus the undisputed shortfall — actual amounts owed, not a stipulated sum. The §2.1 take-or-pay minimum is a volume commitment and is flagged under the minimum-commitment rule, not duplicated here.
